content:
Let \(D\) be the distance from Acaster to Beetown and \(t\) the time until they meet.

Geraint’s distance:
\[
30t = D - 105
\]
so
\[
D = 30t + 105.
\]

Lewis’s total driving distance:
\[
70(t-1) = D + 105.
\]

Substitute \(D = 30t + 105\):
\[
70t - 70 = 30t + 105 + 105
\]
\[
40t = 280
\]
\[
t = 7.
\]

Thus
\[
D = 30(7) + 105 = 315.
\]

\[
\boxed{315 \text{ km}}
\]
